docs.title: About
docs.text:
I'm Matthew Walchinsky. This is my site.

I live in the Philadelphia area. I hold the amateur radio license KC3VKY.

The pages here are Markdown in the walchinsky.com repository. MkDocs and Material for MkDocs build them into the HTML that GitHub Pages serves.

docs.title: TapOut
docs.text:
TapOut is an Android app for screen time. A focus session does not end from a button on the phone. You scan an NFC tag or a QR code you have put somewhere else, so stopping takes a real trip across the room.

Galynte publishes TapOut. The app is based on TapBlok by cajdata, licensed under the Apache License 2.0.

Support mail for the app is dev@galynte.com.
